store_credential_envelope_complete.name: store_credential_envelope_complete
store_credential_envelope_complete.value:
("store"."credential_key_version" IS NULL AND "store"."credential_nonce" IS NULL AND "store"."credential_ciphertext" IS NULL)
    OR ("store"."credential_key_version" IS NOT NULL AND "store"."credential_nonce" IS NOT NULL AND "store"."credential_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL)

conversation_control_counters_valid.name: conversation_control_counters_valid
conversation_control_counters_valid.value: "conversation_control"."version" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "conversation_control"."control_epoch" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "conversation_control"."sequence" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991

sync_cursor_stream_valid.name: sync_cursor_stream_valid
sync_cursor_stream_valid.value: ("sync_cursor"."stream"='discovery' AND "sync_cursor"."thread_id"='' AND "sync_cursor"."conversation_id" IS NULL) OR ("sync_cursor"."stream" IN ('backfill','incremental') AND "sync_cursor"."thread_id"<>'' AND "sync_cursor"."conversation_id" IS NOT NULL)

store_coordinator_lease_complete.name: store_coordinator_lease_complete
store_coordinator_lease_complete.value:
("store_coordinator"."lease_source" IS NULL AND "store_coordinator"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "store_coordinator"."lease_until" IS NULL)
    OR ("store_coordinator"."lease_source" IS NOT NULL AND "store_coordinator"."lease_source" IN ('chat','products','fbs_postings') AND "store_coordinator"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "store_coordinator"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)
